We've just been spotted by some enemies.|audio = HardcoreWave1-1.ogg|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] on Wave 1 ([[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Odd''' is an early-game enemy that appears in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] modes. It has decent health and above average speed. ==Logbook Description== "''The Odd are people who have succumbed to the Void. They are considered a blank slate, something the Void Caster can build off of to create other variations of soldiers for her army. Many of the Odd were from realms the Void had fully consumed. They aren’t particularly special, but when they’re not preserved by Void Caster’s song, they ‘enjoy’ wandering cluelessly about the Void. Like souls seeking passage into the spirit world.''" ==Appearance== The '''Odd''' has white skin, purple torso and purple legs. It has purple veins on its body. It has three walking animations it can choose from. ==Strategy== *Decently strong early-game towers like the [[Engineer]], [[Golden Soldier]], [[Ace Pilot]] or [[Golden Scout]] can fare well against the '''Odd'''. **Towers that can damage multiple enemies at once, like the [[Golden Pyromancer]] and [[Electroshocker]], are effective at dealing with groups of '''Odds'''. *While not necessary, it may be ideal to let '''Odds''' enter the base while upgrading [[Farm]]s. However, you should not rely solely on your base health. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Hardcore Rework Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Odd''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} V1.86.0UpdateLog1.png|'''Odd''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Concept Art}} OddCA.png|'''Odd''' on its concept art. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellanous}} OddIconIG.png|'''Odd''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Odd''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Odd''' added, replacing the [[Abnormal]]. {{Hardcore|Start|N/A|Odd & [[Swift]]|Wave 1|[[Hefty]]|Wave 4}} {{Voidcore|Start|N/A|Odd & [[Swift]]|Wave 1|[[Hefty]]|Wave 4}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Early-Game]]
